name: Arcavios
description: Arcavios is the plane where Strixhaven stands, the home plane of Quint and the students, whose magic is formed of five dichotomies of opposing mana colors.

bio.text: The Theorist plans to lay the Echoverse over the existing Multiverse by studying the creation of Arcavios.

citations.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2026.

status.text: The latest event in the material shows the Theorist planning to study Arcavios's creation in order to lay the Echoverse over the Multiverse.

citations.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Aug 2026.

timeline.summary: The twins arrive on Arcavios where Kasmina and her owl greet them.
timeline.quote: I see you've both made it.

citation.text: "Episode 1: Class Is in Session" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: They pass a huge silver torch on the road to the school.
timeline.quote: The silver column rose high above the trees, piercing the brilliant blue sky.

citation.text: "Episode 1: Class Is in Session" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Masked Oriq mages ambush Lukka and Mila in a desert and take Lukka prisoner.
timeline.quote: Slowly, he raised his hands in surrender.

citation.text: "Episode 1: Class Is in Session" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: In the cave Lukka senses shelled creatures hanging around them.
timeline.quote: Slowly, whatever it was seemed to unfold, stretching long and spindly legs into the darkness.

citation.text: "Episode 1: Class Is in Session" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: A masked man greets Lukka by name and offers to teach him in exchange for favors.
timeline.quote: Welcome to Arcavios, Lukka of Ikoria.

citation.text: "Episode 1: Class Is in Session" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Three weeks earlier, Lukka planeswalks to Arcavios and wanders to a small farming village (flashback).
timeline.quote: his stomach still churning from planeswalking

citation.text: "Episode 2: Lessons" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Villagers accuse Lukka of being an Oriq recruiter and threaten him.
timeline.quote: Okay, Oriq, I think I've heard enough.

citation.text: "Episode 2: Lessons" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Lukka punches one man, then is knocked through a window by another's firebolt.
timeline.quote: Lukka got a few steps away before the firebolt splashed against the back of his coat

citation.text: "Episode 2: Lessons" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Lukka calls village animals to attack his attackers and staggers away hungry.
timeline.quote: a dog leapt through the air, its sharp teeth flashing as they sank into his arm

citation.text: "Episode 2: Lessons" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Starving Lukka nearly falls from a crumbling cliff ledge.
timeline.quote: The ledge suddenly gave way beneath him, crumbling into loose stone.

citation.text: "Episode 2: Lessons" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Lukka finds an injured fox-like creature under a pile of stones.
timeline.quote: A pair of golden eyes looked back out at him.

citation.text: "Episode 2: Lessons" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: The fox leaves berries and nuts beside the fainted Lukka.
timeline.quote: A pile of berries and nuts lay beside his leg.

citation.text: "Episode 2: Lessons" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Lukka forms a bond with the fox-like creature.
timeline.quote: Lukka took a deep breath and cast out his bonder's senses.

citation.text: "Episode 2: Lessons" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Liliana returns empty-handed from Caerdoon and runs into Oriq agents capturing a white stag.
timeline.quote: Liliana pressed against the gnarled trunk of an old tree and watched as the band of Oriq agents surrounded a large white stag.

citation.text: "Episode 2: Lessons" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Lukka watches a Dragonsguard confront masked Oriq agents.
timeline.quote: he could see a woman wearing immaculate robes facing a group of masked individuals

citation.text: "Episode 2: Lessons" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: The Dragonsguard reflects an Oriq curse that nearly hits Lukka and rots a tree.
timeline.quote: He ducked just in time, the spell hissing horribly as it flew overhead and hit a tree to his right.

citation.text: "Episode 2: Lessons" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Lukka summons the forest beasts to the clearing.
timeline.quote: Connecting with the nearby beasts, he summoned each and every one to the clearing.

citation.text: "Episode 2: Lessons" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: The Dragonsguard drags a mage hunter into the earth with roots.
timeline.quote: roots as thick as his arm burst forth from the ground, wrapping around the chitinous legs of the creature

citation.text: "Episode 2: Lessons" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: The Dragonsguard traps Lukka waist-deep in soil, calling him an untrained Oriq hedge-mage.
timeline.quote: the root creeping around his own ankle until it yanked him into the soil down to his waist

citation.text: "Episode 2: Lessons" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: The fox-like creature attacks the Dragonsguard with fire and fells her.
timeline.quote: a familiar shape stood over the Dragonsguard's still body, her fiery tail twitching as she sniffed at her fallen opponent

citation.text: "Episode 2: Lessons" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Lukka renews the bond and names the creature Mila.
timeline.quote: Mila it is.

citation.text: "Episode 2: Lessons" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Extus fails a fourth time to brew a potion in his cave.
timeline.quote: That was the fourth failure.

citation.text: "Episode 2: Lessons" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Extus broods over Oriq agents drained of life for the ritual, which still was not enough.
timeline.quote: every last bit of life drained from their bodies, and it wasn't enough

citation.text: "Episode 2: Lessons" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Extus learns of a beast-calling stranger and says to let him come.
timeline.quote: Let him come.

citation.text: "Episode 2: Lessons" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Dina remembers the Brittleblight destroying her glade and killing its dryads (flashback).
timeline.quote: When the Brittleblight came for her glade, like it had done for many across Arcavios, few noticed its effects.

citation.text: "The Chains That Bind" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Dina recalls that Lisette rescued her from the dying glade (flashback).
timeline.quote: it was she who had arrived at Dina's glade to rescue her before the sickness could take a permanent hold

citation.text: "The Chains That Bind" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: The Founder Dragons are said to have brought the Blood Age to an end.
timeline.quote: The Founder Dragons brought the Blood Age to an end.

citation.text: Dragonsguard Elite (Strixhaven: School of Mages Promos, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: More than 7000 years before 4564 AR, the demi-planes Ezroi and Karudis merge to form Arcavios, creating the snarls.
timeline.quote: two demi- planes , Ezroi and Karudis , merged bizarrely and uniquely

citation.text: "Arcavios", section "Birth of the plane". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The five elder dragons are born from the snarls.
timeline.quote: The five elder dragons of Arcavios were born from these snarls.

citation.text: "Arcavios", section "Birth of the plane". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace, through Jadzi's mind, sees the planes colliding amid Eldrazi horrors.
timeline.quote: formless Eldrazi horrors snaking around the great ships battling them

citation.text: "Arcavios", section "Birth of the plane". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The dragons learn to accept disciplined mortal study of magic as humanoids arise, ending the Dawning Age.
timeline.quote: The humanoids' emergence marked the end of the Dawning Age, replacing it with an age of conflict.

citation.text: "Arcavios", section "Dawning Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Golwanda and Xandril clash around 1539 AR on blood-soaked battlefields.
timeline.quote: the forces of Golwanda the Bloodspiller and Xandril the Executioner clashed on blood-soaked battlefields

citation.text: "Arcavios", section "Blood Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Founder Dragons end the Blood Age by creating an institution to train mages for peace.
timeline.quote: The Founder Dragons brought the Blood Age to an end, creating an institution to train mages for peace.

citation.text: "Arcavios", section "Blood Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Professor Vess thwarts Professor Kasmina's plot to destroy the omenpaths and disintegrate Arcavios.
timeline.quote: Professor Vess thwarted a plot by Professor Kasmina

citation.text: "Arcavios", section "Omenpaths". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Around 4565 AR the archaics become erratic and tensions reignite between Silkmeadow and Tor-Kathorr over All-Gleam.
timeline.quote: many of the normally gentle archaics became erratic and incensed, randomly attacking others on the plane

citation.text: "Arcavios", section "Omenpaths". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the birth of Arcavios, overlapping mana forms five vortices that hatch five dragons.
timeline.quote: Five particularly powerful vortices of overlapping mana became luminous spheres, from which were hatched five dragons

citation.text: "Elder", section "Founder Dragons of Arcavios". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Founder Dragons, once angered at mortals harnessing magic, found Strixhaven to teach disciplined study of the five mana dichotomies.
timeline.quote: the dragons founded an institution devoted to the study of the five mana dichotomies

citation.text: "Elder", section "Founder Dragons of Arcavios". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kasmina invites Rowan and Will Kenrith to study at Strixhaven and guides them to campus.
timeline.quote: Kasmina went to Kylem and invited Rowan and Will Kenrith to study at Strixhaven

citation.text: "Kasmina", section "Strixhaven". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kasmina confronts Lukka, who realizes she was spying; she wins their battle but retreats when mage hunters arrive.
timeline.quote: Kasmina winning but being forced to retreat once swarms of mage hunters arrived

citation.text: "Kasmina", section "Strixhaven". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Liliana becomes Professor Serafina Onyx at Strixhaven.
timeline.quote: Liliana became known as Professor Serafina Onyx

citation.text: "Liliana Vess", section "On Arcavios". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: On Arcavios Lukka bonds with Mila, is captured by the Oriq and meets their leader Extus Narr, who offers a trade.
timeline.quote: Extus explained that there were things he could teach Lukka and proposed a trade.

citation.text: "Lukka", section "Arcavios". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The students return to Arcavios via Shandalar with Ajani, and Lluwen joins the cross-planar program.
timeline.quote: Lluwen joined Strixhaven's cross-planar student program

citation.text: "Sanar", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the birth of Arcavios, snarls of overlapping mana become luminous spheres from which five elder dragons hatch.
timeline.quote: Five particularly powerful snarls of overlapping mana became luminous spheres, from which were hatched five dragons .

citation.text: "Strixhaven", section "The University". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The dragons, once angry at mortals harnessing magic, realize disciplined study is needed; Prismari proposes an institution, which becomes Strixhaven.
timeline.quote: So, around 3861 AR , Prismari had the idea for the dragons to found an institution devoted to the study of the five mana dichotomies

citation.text: "Strixhaven", section "The University". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Founder Dragons withdraw from direct association with Strixhaven, letting the deans speak for them.
timeline.quote: They no longer associate directly with Strixhaven, preferring to let the deans of the college speak in their stead.

citation.text: "Strixhaven", section "The University". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Several planeswalkers seek out Arcavios and Strixhaven as a refuge.
timeline.quote: Several planeswalkers , each with their motivations, have sought out Arcavios and Strixhaven as their refuge.

citation.text: "Strixhaven: School of Mages", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Eula accepts an invitation to Strixhaven's first multiplanar class.
timeline.quote: Eula leapt to take it.

citation.text: "Eula Blue", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Eula discovers she can make black-mana shields; the Arcavios Preservation Society abducts her and Segante saves her.
timeline.quote: She was saved by Segante

citation.text: "Eula Blue", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kasmina's plot to force the students to ignite and steal their sparks is thwarted; she presumably dies in a snarl.
timeline.quote: Kasmina presumably died in the final confrontation in the heart of a snarl

citation.text: "Eula Blue", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Angrath loses his spark in the Desparkening and travels with his daughters through Omenpaths, agreeing Jamira should attend Strixhaven.
timeline.quote: Angrath lost his spark in the Desparkening .

citation.text: "Angrath", section "Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace and Vivien persuade Lukka to join the Mirrans' strike on New Phyrexia, promising he could return home a hero.
timeline.quote: Lukka initially refused, but was eventually convinced by Vivien Reid

citation.text: "Lukka", section "Against the Phyrexians". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Invocation of the Founders temporarily thwarts the invasion of Arcavios.
timeline.quote: The Invocation of the Founders temporarily thwarted the invasion

citation.text: "New Phyrexian Invasion", section "Arcavios". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Quintorius Kand vanishes as his spark ignites from casting the Invocation.
timeline.quote: Quintorius Kand had vanished, his planeswalker's spark ignited by the stress of casting the Invocation

citation.text: "New Phyrexian Invasion", section "Arcavios". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The students thwart the plot and Kasmina presumably dies in the final confrontation in the heart of a snarl.
timeline.quote: This plot was thwarted by the students working together, and Kasmina presumably died in the final confrontation

citation.text: "Kasmina", section "Omens of Chaos". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Niko and Tyvar accompany Zimone back to Arcavios, and she finishes her graduate degree.
timeline.quote: Zimone completed her graduate degree by c. 4565 AR .

citation.text: "Zimone Wola", section "On Duskmourn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ajani learns Bolas escaped the Meditation Realm and that Jace's spell seemingly unmade him.
timeline.quote: Bolas, who had secretly survived the War of the Spark to be imprisoned in the Realm, had escaped

citation.text: "Ajani Goldmane", section "Strixhaven advisorship". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ajani protects the Dawning Archaic from Chandra.
timeline.quote: but Ajani protected it and fought her off

citation.text: "Ajani Goldmane", section "Strixhaven advisorship". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The five Founder Sphinxes, created at Arcavios's largest leyline confluence, found Hexhaven to share magic with the plane's denizens.
timeline.quote: With the other four sphinxes, they helped found Hexhaven, sharing their knowledge of magic with the plane's denizens to protect them from the turbulent world.

citation.text: "List of secondary characters/Echoverse", section "Aerid Konstrari". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The students land in an unfamiliar meadow of spiral-patterned flowers and floating stones and realize from the single sun that they are not on Arcavios.
timeline.quote: "Not on Arcavios," said Tam.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 1: Out of This Wood
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 1: Out of This Wood" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: Ajani leads the group through an Omenpath to Shandalar and on to Arcavios, bringing Lluwen.
timeline.quote: Together, they walked into the cascading light, and another world was left behind.

citation.work: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 7: The Charm Dissolves Apace
citation.text: "Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 7: The Charm Dissolves Apace" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Dec 2025.

timeline.summary: The students accompany Ajani through another Omenpath back to Arcavios; Lluwen joins Strixhaven's cross-planar program.
timeline.quote: the students accompanied Ajani through another Omenpath

citation.text: "Abigale", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Two demi-planes, Ezroi and Karudis, are theorized to have merged, knotting contrasting mana types into the five dichotomies.
timeline.quote: two demi-planes, Ezroi and Karudis, merged as a result of an unknown cosmic event.

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Secrets of Strixhaven
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Secrets of Strixhaven" by Lauren Bond, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: The Dawning Age ends as younger humanoid species rise and bring war.
timeline.quote: The Dawning Age ended when younger species of humanoid creatures rose to prominence and brought with them a time of war.

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Secrets of Strixhaven
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Secrets of Strixhaven" by Lauren Bond, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: The Blood Age ends when five elder dragons found Strixhaven University.
timeline.quote: It was only when five mighty elder dragons came together and founded Strixhaven University that the Blood Age finally came to an end

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Secrets of Strixhaven
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Secrets of Strixhaven" by Lauren Bond, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Each Founder Dragon consolidates the study of two mana colors into a college, and mages become the most powerful force.
timeline.quote: Each dragon consolidated the study of its two mana colors into a magical college

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Secrets of Strixhaven
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Secrets of Strixhaven" by Lauren Bond, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Archaics become erratic and rampage across the plane, and Jadzi seeks the cause.
timeline.quote: Currently, many of the normally gentle archaics have become erratic and incensed.

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Secrets of Strixhaven
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Secrets of Strixhaven" by Lauren Bond, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Mar 2026.

timeline.summary: Jadzi, burdened by guilt over not predicting the invasion, now wanders the plane repairing damage.
timeline.quote: She harbors a quiet guilt that she was unable to predict and protect the plane more from the Phyrexian Invasion

citation.work: The Legends of Secrets of Strixhaven
citation.text: "The Legends of Secrets of Strixhaven" by Lauren Bond, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: The Dawning Archaic, formed from the soul of the last oracle, is sundered from mana and time by an unknown phenomenon.
timeline.quote: The Dawning Archaic was formed from the soul of what will be the last-ever oracle on the plane.

citation.work: The Legends of Secrets of Strixhaven
citation.text: "The Legends of Secrets of Strixhaven" by Lauren Bond, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: Dina survives the Brittleblight alone, and later fails to restore her glade.
timeline.quote: She was the sole survivor of a dryad glade hit by the Brittleblight

citation.work: The Legends of Secrets of Strixhaven
citation.text: "The Legends of Secrets of Strixhaven" by Lauren Bond, Laurel Pratt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2026.

timeline.summary: Willowdusk and others woke the forest against the Phyrexian threat.
timeline.quote: We woke the forest against the Phyrexian threat, and it's refused to go back to sleep.

citation.text: Awaken the Woods (Secrets of Strixhaven Mystical Archive, 2026), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Lluwen, with the help of others, calmed the Dawning Archaic.
timeline.quote: By himself, Lluwen couldn't have hoped to calm the Dawning Archaic

citation.text: Together as One (Secrets of Strixhaven Promos, 2026), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The archaics rampaged, and worse followed.
timeline.quote: In the wake of the archaics' rampage, much worse was to come.

citation.text: Tragedy Feaster (Secrets of Strixhaven Promos, 2026), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: After the Invasion, Willowdusk's office became an unofficial hideaway for overwhelmed students.
timeline.quote: Willowdusk's office turned into an unofficial hideaway for overwhelmed students.

citation.text: Comforting Counsel (Secrets of Strixhaven Promos, 2026), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Moseo shucked his flesh to combat the Phyrexian infection.
timeline.quote: When I shucked my flesh to combat the Phyrexian infection, it was not loss to me, merely a new state of being.

citation.text: Deathcap Glade (Secrets of Strixhaven Promos, 2026), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Augusta's fail-safe spell activated upon her death.
timeline.quote: My fail-safe spell, activated upon my death, was precaution born from tales of the careless.

citation.text: Sundown Pass (Secrets of Strixhaven Promos, 2026), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Most archaics raged across Arcavios.
timeline.quote: Even as most archaics raged across Arcavios

citation.text: Transcendent Archaic (Secrets of Strixhaven, 2026), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Dina graduates, becomes a teaching assistant, and loses four students lured through an Omenpath by Oko; Ajani offers to track them down.
timeline.quote: who were lured through an Omenpath by the faerie planeswalker Oko .

citation.text: "Dina", section "Post-invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: To stabilize the Echoverse the Theorist creates Hexhaven as his inner sanctum.
timeline.quote: Hexhaven was created as his inner sanctum

citation.text: "Hexhaven", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Harmonious mana merges and creates five elder sphinxes at the largest leyline confluence.
timeline.quote: harmonious mana merged, creating five elder sphinxes at the largest confluence of its leylines

citation.text: "Hexhaven", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The elder sphinxes protect the people from the disasters caused by the Theorist's reality magic and found an institution to train them.
timeline.quote: the sphinxes formally founded an institution

citation.text: "Hexhaven", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Strange events occur on Arcavios as alternate versions of Liliana and Ral appear.
timeline.quote: Liliana Vess received another strange visitor: a white -aligned version of herself.

citation.work: Jace Beleren's attempt to fix the Multiverse
citation.text: "Jace Beleren's attempt to fix the Multiverse", section "Creation of the Echoverse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Chandra arrives on Arcavios searching for Jace, takes in the Shattered and hunts the Dawning Archaic.
timeline.quote: Arriving on Arcavios , she met the Shattered , a group of former Oriq pyromancers.
